title: River AI
strategy: dev-community → 开发者痛点海报 / 讨论信息图，强调「开发者一眼共情」
visual_subjects: quote card with developer workspace background
composition_notes: Top: short hook quote (3-6 words). Middle: 1-2 line "pain point" statement. Bottom: subtle attribution.
Use a developer workspace scene in the background, blurred.
reference_phrases: A personal note from Igor Babuschkin, co-founder & CEO of River AI, on why we are building personal AI.
english_prompt: A developer community discussion poster. topic "River AI" as a short hook at the top in rounded sans-serif. central visual: a stylized developer workspace with three monitors showing code, terminal, and chat. bottom one-liner summarizing the pain point in italics. style: editorial flat illustration, pastel pink and slate, soft shadows, minimal. no faces, no company logos
negative_prompt: low quality, blurry, distorted, watermark, signature, text overlay, ugly, deformed hands, extra fingers, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, photographic, cinematic, anime
intent_zh: 把开发者社区的讨论包成「开发者一眼共情」的痛点海报。话题：River AI。简介：A personal note from Igor Babuschkin, co-founder & CEO of River AI, on why we are building personal AI.。核心思路：上方一句 hook 短语（3-6 字），中间 1-2 句痛点描述，底部归属
